threads.body: `to_input_messages` now silently drops any non-`BaseMessage` entries. For LangGraph-style `("human", "...")` tuples this avoids the AttributeError, but it also means the user prompt is not recorded at all (and `make_input_message` won’t fall back because the `messages` key is present). If the goal is to support raw tuple messages, consider converting them into `InputMessage` entries rather than skipping.

replies.body: Yes, I will have to rephrase it. I was thinking instead of skipping, we should convert any non-standard messages into BaseMessage format so we don't loose the prompt and important attributes. There is a method in langchain_core named [`convert_to_messages`](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/blob/00c0f69dc0dfd619f023f1ee9dc83574d8a173ed/libs/core/langchain_core/messages/utils.py#L706) that normalizes formats that langchain accepts to BaseMessage.
